w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🩸 The Redactor mauled Dmitri (-39 health) over 3 rounds. They're lucky to be breathing.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Chorus Line is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Ad Break is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Spoiler
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Spoiler.
firstContext: Saiful catches your eye across the fire. "help Saiful with their injury" — done. You kept your word. That meant everything.
Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
Something moves out there — The Spoiler.
👁️ Saiful freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

w5Mentions.name: The Timeslot
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
firstContext: This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 2 tiles to grove.
Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
👁️ Saiful freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Saiful: "Huh. Never been this way before."

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: ◈ SYSTEM: "The long game, little hoarders. A GRANARY. Stockpile 20,000 kcal, 500 wood and 2,000 kcal of PRESERVED food — food that WAITS. Smoke it, dry it, render it. The audience finds delayed gratification EXOTIC. So do stomachs, we are told."
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 8,1. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
firstContext: 🤒 Meera is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse.
📻 The System whispers it, for once not delighted: the Finale. Every season needs its climax. This one is yours.

📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 8,1. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.
🌪️ THE FINALE fed in the night — 480 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
— DAY 88 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (23/14/7), with 6 wave-4 and 1 wave-5 fought, 6 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 5 · Forage 24 · Craft 9 · Talk 14 · Explore 44 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Ivy Wang ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high again — evening after evening, lower.
⚠ The store has fallen further still from its recent high.

hurtreturn.line: 🧭 Stephen returns from the wilds hurt (health 7/100) — the trip cut short.
🧭 Ruth returns from the wilds hurt (health 2/100) — the trip cut short.
